findings.title: Article/NewsArticle JSON-LD missing required properties across 6 pages
findings.evidence: Found Article/NewsArticle JSON-LD blocks missing required fields: author across 6 pages: https://stripe.com/in/newsroom/news/bfcm2025, https://stripe.com/in/newsroom/news/google-and-stripe, https://stripe.com/in/newsroom/news/stripe-ford-agreement, https://stripe.com/in/newsroom/news/stripe-openai-instant-checkout, https://stripe.com/in/newsroom/news/stripe-and-uber, https://stripe.com/in/newsroom/news/nvidia-collaboration-with-stripe.

suggested_action.summary: Add the following required properties to your Article/NewsArticle JSON-LD across affected pages: author. See schema.org/Article for full spec.

findings.mechanism: Incomplete Article schemas missing required author properties fail validation in search crawlers and degrade AI citation attribution.

findings.title: Product pages detected but no Product JSON-LD found
findings.evidence: URL patterns suggest this site has product pages (paths matching /product/, /shop/, /item/), but no Product schema.org JSON-LD was found on any of them.

suggested_action.summary: Add Product JSON-LD to all product pages with at minimum: name, description, offers (price, priceCurrency, availability), image, brand.

findings.mechanism: Missing Product structured data leaves AI models guessing SaaS pricing, tiers, and capabilities from unstructured marketing copy.

findings.title: Physical address inconsistency — 24 variants found
findings.evidence: Found 24 distinct address strings across pages. Details: '1 University Avenue, 10th Floor Toronto ON M5J 2P1' on: https://stripe.com; '1 Wilton Park, Wilton Place, Grand Canal Street Lower Dublin 2 D02 FX04' on: https://stripe.com; '10 Boulevard Haussmann, 2nd Floor Paris Île-de-France 75009' on: https://stripe.com; '201 Bishopsgate, 5th Floor London EC2M 3AB' on: https://stripe.com. Address inconsistency is a strong negative signal for AI confidence in local business data.

suggested_action.summary: Standardize your address in a single CMS variable. Use a structured address in Organization/LocalBusiness JSON-LD with: streetAddress, addressLocality, addressRegion, postalCode, addressCountry.

findings.mechanism: Conflicting corporate addresses across domain pages lower retrieval model confidence and increase hallucination risks in AI responses.

findings.title: No content freshness signals found on any page
findings.evidence: Checked 15 pages. 0 pages contain dateModified, datePublished (JSON-LD), article:modified_time, or og:updated_time (meta tags). AI crawlers cannot determine whether this site's content is current.

suggested_action.summary: Add datePublished and dateModified to all Article/BlogPosting JSON-LD. Add <meta property='article:modified_time' content='...ISO date...'> to all content pages. Include <lastmod> dates in your sitemap.xml.

findings.mechanism: Lack of modification timestamps prevents AI crawlers from evaluating whether API and product documentation is up-to-date.

findings.title: 29.4% of content on / requires JS to render
findings.evidence: Raw HTML: 1889 words. Playwright-rendered: 2334 words. Render gap: 29.4%. Affected URL: https://stripe.com

suggested_action.summary: Review client-side-only components. Move key informational content to server-rendered or static HTML.

findings.mechanism: AI search engines without headless browser rendering engines miss over a quarter of homepage content rendered solely via client-side JavaScript.

findings.title: Article JSON-LD missing high-value recommended properties on /in/blog/introducing-our-agentic-commerce-solutions
findings.evidence: Page: https://stripe.com/in/blog/introducing-our-agentic-commerce-solutions. Article JSON-LD present and required fields satisfied, but missing recommended fields: description. These fields significantly improve AI citation quality.

suggested_action.summary: Add recommended properties to Article JSON-LD: description.

findings.mechanism: Missing description fields in Article schemas reduce snippet clarity and precision when AI assistants synthesize answers.

findings.title: sameAs present but missing high-trust disambiguators: Wikidata
findings.evidence: Found sameAs links to: GitHub, YouTube, Wikipedia, Instagram, Facebook, Crunchbase, Twitter/X, LinkedIn. Missing high-trust identity anchors: Wikidata. Wikidata/Wikipedia/Crunchbase entries are the strongest signals for AI entity resolution.

suggested_action.summary: Add the following to your sameAs array: Wikidata. If no Wikidata entry exists for your brand, create one at https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Special:NewItem

findings.mechanism: Absence of canonical Wikidata links impedes global LLM knowledge base alignment, where Wikidata serves as the primary entity identifier.

findings.title: No call-to-action detected above the fold on homepage
findings.evidence: Scanned the first 25% of homepage (https://stripe.com) HTML body for CTA keywords (get started, start free, sign up, signup, try for free, try free, free trial, buy now...). None found in above-fold region. Visitors arriving from AI assistant recommendations need an immediate next action.

suggested_action.summary: Place a prominent CTA button/link in the hero section of the homepage. Use action-oriented text (e.g., 'Start Free Trial', 'Get a Demo', 'Shop Now'). Ensure it's visible without scrolling on desktop (above ~700px).

findings.mechanism: Visitors referred from AI assistant recommendations bounce when an immediate conversion pathway or trial button is absent above the fold.

findings.title: About page lacks sufficient disambiguating identity facts (score: 0/6)
findings.evidence: About page: https://stripe.com/about. Detected disambiguating facts: none. Missing categories: founding year, location hq, industry vertical, team size, customer count, geographic reach. Generic About pages increase the risk of AI entity confusion.

suggested_action.summary: Improve the About page to include specific facts: founding year, HQ city/country, industry vertical, team size, customer count, and geographic reach. These specifics help AI models build an accurate entity profile.

findings.mechanism: An About page missing core corporate identifiers forces AI models to rely on secondary, unverified web sources for entity facts.

beyond_problem_suggestions.title: Cross-link verified entity profiles across independent authority platforms via sameAs
beyond_problem_suggestions.rationale: Independent corroboration across Wikipedia, Crunchbase, LinkedIn, and Wikidata validates brand legitimacy and feeds entity resolution algorithms in knowledge graph construction.
beyond_problem_suggestions.mechanism: LLM knowledge engines construct high-confidence entity nodes by resolving bidirectional sameAs references across independent high-authority knowledge bases.

beyond_problem_suggestions.title: Publish a canonical facts page with unambiguous declarative plain-text assertions
beyond_problem_suggestions.rationale: A dedicated /facts or /about page presenting one unambiguous plain-text sentence per core attribute (founding date, headquarters, leadership, core products) eliminates extraction ambiguity for LLM crawlers.
beyond_problem_suggestions.mechanism: Declarative single-fact sentences minimize semantic parsing entropy during retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and prevent hallucinated brand claims.

beyond_problem_suggestions.title: Structure conversational FAQ sections with question-shaped headings matching user prompts
beyond_problem_suggestions.rationale: Formulating headings as explicit natural-language questions directly mirrors user prompt patterns submitted to AI search engines.
beyond_problem_suggestions.mechanism: Question-formatted headings maximize semantic vector cosine similarity against conversational user queries, triggering direct answer citations.

beyond_problem_suggestions.title: Implement hreflang annotations and locale-specific schema for regional disambiguation
beyond_problem_suggestions.rationale: Explicit hreflang link tags and localized schema markup distinguish regional product lines, currencies, and language variations for global AI assistants.
beyond_problem_suggestions.mechanism: Locale and alternate tags prevent search bots from conflating regional entities or surfacing incorrect currency and availability in localized AI answers.

beyond_problem_suggestions.title: Embed machine-readable TL;DR summary blocks at the top of transactional emails
beyond_problem_suggestions.rationale: AI email summarizers (e.g., Apple Intelligence, Gemini in Gmail, Copilot) generate automatic summaries based on early email tokens, requiring key details upfront.
beyond_problem_suggestions.mechanism: Structured key-value summary blocks at the beginning of email HTML ensure client-side AI summarizers extract order numbers, dates, and actions without truncation errors.

beyond_problem_suggestions.title: Maintain accurate <lastmod> timestamps in sitemap.xml to signal content freshness
beyond_problem_suggestions.rationale: Including precise, genuine <lastmod> dates in sitemap.xml enables AI crawlers with limited crawl budgets to discover and ingest fresh updates promptly.
beyond_problem_suggestions.mechanism: AI search engines prioritize re-crawling URLs with recent sitemap <lastmod> timestamps, keeping their retrieval indexes and vector embeddings synchronized.
